scope: Exact offline exercise-only corrections; no canonical dialogue changed. Changed chips bind the sentence boundary and changed cloze choices test discourse, not only verb endings.

edits.reason: Old chip 1 ended on the internal sentence boundary, so the two sentences could be swapped into a second valid order. The period now sits inside chip 2 ("pararse. ¿Podría"); only "La lavadora" can begin (sole capitalized chip), chip 2 is the only chip that can follow it, and chip 3 must precede "del importe?", giving a unique order. Cross-sentence chip has honest glosses for both ends in de/en. Text, punctuation, and joins are byte-identical to the canonical speech; no chip duplicates another or a distractor.
Rival 'mientras' not offered; desde/durante/tras + preterite 'oí' ungrammatical. 'giraban' excluded by singular 'el tambor' cue. Imperfect-vs-preterite contrast still visible via 'cuando oí'.
Rival 'cuando se lee' absent; para/desde/durante cannot precede 'se lee'. 'servirían' blocked by singular 'una foto' cue.

Indirect question needs accented 'cuándo'; durante/hacia/entre invalid before 'esperan'. No unaccented 'cuando' trap. 'Podrían' (ustedes) formal plural excluded by explicit usted cue; warehouse plural stays in untouched 'esperan'.

Infinitive 'aceptar' licenses only 'antes de'; 'hasta que/mientras que/dado que' require finite verbs. 'Podríamos' excluded by usted cue; dropping 'Quiero' blank removes the credible 'Queremos' household reading.
